label: GO step after a rewarded trial, late in the episode, when the agent is choosing a1 or the rewarded trial was rare
explanation: Fires only at GO steps, and only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 covers 100% of activations; it never fires at D1/D2 or after unrewarded trials). It is strongly gated by episode position: almost silent before trial ~30, rising to a peak around trials 70-89 and falling at 90-99. GO & prev_reward==1 alone gives recall 1.0 but precision 0.32 (dev). Adding ep_trial>=50 gives F1 0.66 with mass recall 0.91. Within that set it prefers GO steps where the agent picks a1, or where the rewarded trial had a rare transition (the model-based switch case). The top activations are switches to a2 after a rare-rewarded a1 trial, plus a1 choices. The recorded predicate uses the agent own upcoming choice (action at GO), which is marked FUTURE but is computed by the agent; the observed-only clause prev_common==0 covers the rare-rewarded part. Dev F1 0.71, mass recall 0.84. An alternative using the model value (GO & prev_reward==1 & 5.2<value<7.5) scores F1 0.73, so the feature fires when value is moderate and is silent at the highest values. Magnitude is largest for a2 choices after rare-rewarded trials and late in the episode. Remaining errors are mostly false positives on a2 repeats under good=S2.
